questions.q: Why does adding more satellites to the same SSO rideshare barely shorten the contact gap?
options: Because they share one orbital plane, so they pass over Hanoi at the same times
Because the battery is too small

questions.q: At 520 km, roughly what share of each orbit does a satellite spend in Earth’s shadow (eclipse)?
Flying at 600 km without a drag sail breaks which rule?
options: It stays in orbit more than 5 years after the mission

questions.q: With UHF at 9.6 kbps and 17 minutes of contact per day, about how much data comes down?
What does an 8 dB link margin mean?
options: The signal is about 6 times stronger than the minimum needed
